name: 절 깊이 분석
description: 측정합니다 the nesting depth of clauses 내의 sentences 감지하기 위해 AI 생성 text's tendency toward shallow embedding structures.
useCase: Detecting AI text through uniform and shallow subordinate clause 패턴
mechanism: Parses sentences into clause hierarchies and 측정 embedding depth (main clause → subordinate clause → embedded clause). Computes maximum depth, mean depth, depth 분산, and depth 분포 per sentence. AI 생성 text typically shows lower maximum clause depth and less variation in depth 에 걸친 sentences, reflecting a flatter information packaging strategy compared to human writers who naturally vary 사이의 simple and deeply embedded constructions.
source: Hunt, K. W. (1965) - Grammatical Structures Written at Three Grade Levels, NCTE Research Report
algorithm: Clause Boundary Detection + Depth Calculation + Statistical Distribution Analysis
parameters: Parser: dependency-based clause segmenter, Depth metrics: max/mean/분산/분포, Sentence min: 5 words, Text min: 10 sentences
strengths:
• Captures information packaging complexity
• Linguistically well-motivated 특징
• Complementary to sentence-level metrics
• Effective on formal and academic writing
limitations:
• Parser-dependent 정확도
• Some genres favor simple clause structures naturally
• Modern LLMs can produce complex embeddings
• Requires reliable clause boundary 감지
